# Archived current MuJoCo baseline

This directory is a byte-preserved archive of the repository's
`src/rebotarm_simulation/` tree immediately before the upstream source swap on
2026-08-07.

It is retained for rollback, comparison, and the explicit current compatibility
adapter. It is not part of the active colcon source tree. The active
`src/rebotarm_simulation/` package now contains the pinned
`huangbinai/robotarm_ros2` MuJoCo core.

`ARCHIVE_MANIFEST.json` records the SHA-256 and byte size of every non-cache
file in this archive. Do not edit the archive in place; if a comparison change
is needed, create a separate copy and record the new provenance.
